Hero_Desc_Nicole:
Nicole, a veteran director who has produced numerous movies and the Elemental of film.
Having swept countless awards, she is currently the most celebrated film director in Elias.
She usually pretends to be refined and modest, but when her composure collapses, her frantic true self is laid bare.
Album_Hate_Nicole: Repeated failed takes, situations where the energy drags
Album_Hobby_Nicole: Rereading scenarios she scribbled in the past
Album_Wish_Nicole: To keep releasing new work without losing her composure
Album_Nicole1: Nicole is a veteran film director who has made countless movies, as well as the Elemental of film. She possesses exceptional skill and boundless confidence, but the standards she demands of herself are so high that she sometimes becomes discouraged or acts eccentric.
Album_Nicole2: Nicole cares deeply about her image. She always tries to present herself as a cool, veteran director, but she is not meticulous enough to maintain the act, so that image falls apart more easily than one might expect.
Album_Nicole3: Nicole says she was born from a blank reel of film that had fallen inside a theater. Thanks to that, she was able to spend her time watching the countless movies screened there.
Album_Nicole4: When Nicole suffers a breakdown, she mutters incomprehensible things without end. The moment someone asks whether anything is wrong, she might suddenly erupt with a bizarre scream. Since her reactions are impossible to predict, it is best to leave her alone at such times.
Album_Nicole5: Surprisingly, Nicole feels little stress when one of her films sparks fierce debate between supporters and critics. According to her, that still proves something went pa-pop inside the audience's hearts.
Album_Nicole6: Nicole detests boring conversations and stories that repeat without ever reaching an ending. If she hears such a conversation nearby, she cannot restrain herself from stepping in and bringing it to some kind of conclusion.
Album_Nicole7: Since joining the Order, Nicole often rattles off movie ideas based on the Order. The problem is that every one of those ideas is unconventional... for better or worse.
LoveHero_Nicole: As expected, you have an eye for things that go pa-pop~! Heehee!
LoveHeroCancel_Nicole: Hweeek~?! N-No, ahem, um... Fine, have it your way! ...Sniff.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Hate1: The moment Nicole saw the space rations, she screamed that they reminded her of a dreary shoot. She was so loud that we eventually had no choice but to send her outside.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Hate2: Nicole frowned, saying that merely looking at this food made her feel damp and soggy.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like1: The instant the popcorn appeared, Nicole cried, 'Wababa-pa-pop!' She tried one, declared it perfectly popped, and gave a delighted smile.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like10: Nicole said she felt dramatically healthier the moment she ate it. Somehow, even her distinctive dark circles seemed a little lighter.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like2: After smelling the acrid gunpowder scent rising from the creme brulee, she rejoiced that inspiration was surging through her for a pa-pop explosive action film.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like3: She praised it highly, saying that one bowl made her feel completely satisfied and that food like this during a shoot could keep her filming all day with ease.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like4: Nicole seemed to draw some kind of inspiration from the fact that it looked like wood at first glance, yet was actually chocolate cake.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like5: She said the sharp tartness snapped her wide awake, and that with this around, she might be able to drink a little less coffee.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like6: She was delighted, saying it somehow tasted like food made by an expert. Apparently, she could tell because she was an expert herself.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like7: She was pleased that its dazzling appearance and outstanding flavor made it feel just like watching one of her own movies.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like8: Nicole looked amazed that shimmering golden powder could taste so good, then abruptly pulled out her ideas notebook and began writing something down.
Food_ChefNote_Nicole_Like9: Nicole said that keeping one of these candies in her mouth might soothe her when she becomes irritable. She seemed to like them quite a bit, so I wrapped up several for her.

LoveLetter_Nicole:
Hello, Master.

It was true before as well, but how should I put it... Even now, thanks to you, I spend my days with inspiration going pa-pa-pop!

Oh, right. The reason I contacted you is... I would like to send you an invitation to the preview screening of my latest film. You... have time, do you not? I-I want you to see this movie as soon as possible... H-Hehe... I really, truly hope you will come! Please, ngh...!
LoveCall_Nicole:
H-Hehehe... Hello, Maaaster~ It is Nicooole~
Why am I calling all of a sudden? Why am I so listless again?
Heehee, do not even ask. This is a full-blown Nicole crisis~!!
I need an idea for my next movie, but I cannot think of a si~ngle thing!
Every time I try to find inspiration, instead... I keep thinking about you, Master!
Why? Why could that be...? Have I completely lost it? Have I become a blockhead director?!
H-Hehe... Yes, it is utterly strange, right? It makes no sense at all! Kheeeng!

...The truth is, there is one perfectly plausible reason for all this.
It is... um, well... perhaps a kind of cliche? ...What kind of cliche? D-Do not ask!
A-Anyway! Take responsibility! I cannot concentrate on my next movie because of you, Master!
...S-So let us meet for a little while. You know what I mean, right? Make some time for me!
Th-That is all!
